title: Lf-Pistons
description: Fully automatic crop harvesting with pistons — zero redstone!
body:
# 🟧 LF-Pistons
### 🔵 Smart Crop Control with Pistons

---

## 🔥 About
LF-Pistons is a lightweight and optimized plugin that changes how crops behave when pistons are placed nearby.

Instead of allowing normal growth, the plugin intelligently detects pistons adjacent to crops and controls their behavior — perfect for preventing automation abuse and balancing farms.

---

## ⚙️ Features
- 🔴 **[NEW]** Change piston type directly from the menu  
- 🔴 **[NEW]** Language system *(default: English, configurable in config.yml)*  
- Detects pistons near crops in real-time  
- Cancels plant growth when piston is adjacent  
- Supports multiple crop types  
- Clean and optimized performance  
- Fully configurable  
- Built-in GUI system  
- All supported crops enabled by default  

---

## 🌱 Supported Crops
- Pumpkin  
- Melon  
- Bamboo  
- Sugar Cane  
- Cave Vines  
- Amethyst Cluster  
- Cactus  
- Kelp  
- Kelp Plant  
- Wheat  
- Carrots  
- Potatoes  
- Beetroots  
- Nether Wart  
- Cocoa  
- Sweet Berry Bush  
- Torchflower Crop  
- Pitcher Crop  

---

## 🚀 Performance
- Optimized for large farms  
- Low TPS impact  
- Smart event handling  

---

## 📥 Installation
1. Download the plugin  
2. Place the `.jar` file inside your `/plugins/` folder  
3. Restart your server  

---

## ⚙️ Commands
- `/lfpistons` → Shows plugin info  
- `/lfpistons reload` → Reloads config  
- `/lfpistons menu` → Opens plant GUI  

---

## 🔑 Permissions
- `lfpistons.admin` → Full access
